# Repository contribution notes

The canonical contribution guide is [`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)
with its [Simplified Chinese version](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md). Read
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before asking an agent to modify this repository.

This repository keeps a bilingual documentation contract. A change to rules, AI,
WASM, the server boundary, or player-visible UI is incomplete until both language
pages are updated and the applicable checks are recorded.
